text: こんな　とこ　まで　くる　とは　きみも　マニア？

structure.jp: こんな　とこ　まで
structure.en: all the way to a place like this

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a verb shows the speaker is surprised by that action. くる　とは = 'to think that you'd come'.

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.span: こんな　とこ　まで
patterns.explanation: まで means 'as far as', and here it stresses how far out this is. こんな　とこ　まで = 'all the way out to a place like this'.
